$comment: Programs the pack's mods run. scripts/install.mjs reads this file; tests/requirements.test.cjs fails when a mod runs a program listed in neither programs nor system.

git.why: Branch, worktree and change views in most panels.

install.hint: https://cli.github.com, then run gh auth login
Node.js 22.15 or newer from https://nodejs.org or a version manager such as mise

python3.why: Prompt timeline parsing; reading OpenCode's link context for Markdown clicks.

hc.why: Terminal details for the usage-limits bar.

install.hint: Ships with Herdr App as herdr-core; reinstall or update Herdr App if hc is not on PATH.

terminal-browser.why: Opens web pages in a terminal pane (Web panel).

lsof.why: Finds local dev servers for the Web panel.

ss.why: Finds local dev servers for the Web panel.

go.why: Builds the branch-pr helper (herdr-pr); needed only until it is built.

herdr.why: GitHub actions in the tui-prefix overlay (Herdr TUI with the herdr-github plugin).

install.hint: Herdr TUI with the herdr-github plugin; only tui-prefix's GitHub actions use it.

code.why: Open in VS Code button in cockpit.

install.hint: Install VS Code and its code shell command.

branch-pr.why: Go bridge (herdr-pr) the branch-pr mod calls for GitHub data.
